description: A pull request can reach calibration and merge with files outside the plan touch set: the Stage 3 touch-set check exists, but nothing checks the commits the review-loop resolver adds, and Stage 5 does not look at the pull request diff. A merged pull request carried 16 files outside its intent scope.
goal: Check each commit the review-loop resolver makes (flow/review/resolver.py) against the plan touch set with the same guard Stage 3 uses (flow/stages/touch_set_guard.py) and refuse a commit touching a file outside it with touch_set_violation unless a recorded re-plan appended to the plans ledger widens the touch set to include that file. Make Stage 5 (flow/stage5.py) refuse calibration when the pull request diff holds an out-of-scope file without such a re-plan, and make the readiness check output list every out-of-scope file in the diff. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Review and calibration judge the diff against the intent, so an out-of-scope file that slips in is never questioned.
acceptance_criteria: Resolver commits touching a file outside the plan touch set are refused with `touch_set_violation`.
A recorded re-plan that widens the touch set lets the same file through.
Stage 5 refuses calibration when the PR diff has an out-of-scope file without a re-plan.
The readiness check lists out-of-scope files.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_diff_stays_in_intent_scope.py uses the file list of the pull request that merged with 16 out-of-scope files (outcome.py, model_tiers.py, review/loop.py, conftest.py, test_uv_lock.py and the other 11 files) against the intent scope of its bean, and fails before the change and passes after it.
Code has no docstrings and no comments except `# why:`; run with `uv run pytest`.
